verdict.rationale: Kong's own materials say it is a reverse-proxy API gateway offering "advanced routing, load balancing, health checking", configurable via the Admin API or declarative config. Its plugins cover "req/res transformations", which together match all three parts of the story. The single community report of intermittent 404s from router-cache staleness is a bug on the very old 0.14.1/Cassandra setup and self-corrects, so it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on load-balancing algorithms and upstream/target configuration, specific documentation of the request/response transformer plugins, and independent hands-on corroboration on current versions.
